overview: To get rid of a Kraken hold, first check your account status and complete any pending identity verification (KYC) requirements. ☎ 1⇌[833➣590➣1784] Next, review recent activity such as password changes, new device logins, or failed transactions that may have triggered the security hold. ☎ 1⇌[833➣590➣1784]  Ensure your deposit has enough blockchain confirmations and all payment details are correct and fully matched with your account. ☎ 1⇌[833➣590➣1784] If the hold still remains, contacting Kraken support is the fastest way to review and resolve the restriction. ☎ 1⇌[833➣590➣1784]
